purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Japan–Korea Currency Defense — July–August 2026
question: What did Japan, Korea, the U.S. and the IMF actually do during the July 30, 2026 currency defense?
bluf: Japan officially confirmed a coordinated July 31 (U.S. Eastern) yen purchase, and its Ministry of Finance disclosed ¥15.399 trillion of intervention from July 30 to August 26 (direction not yet disclosed, after ¥11.735 trillion of confirmed yen buying in April–June); the exact daily reconciliation stays open. Korea's intervention rests on market-source reports, with no official amount. A formal joint Japan–Korea operation is not officially confirmed, a U.S. rate check is reported but not confirmed, and no record shows the IMF authorizing or executing any trade.
use_note: Catalog entry added 2026-10-03 when International Monetary Transition was split into its sub-studies (Katie); files stay where they are and remain members of the parent study.
